residue.statement: The cargo-fmt proxy exists, but the rustfmt component is absent from the active Rust toolchain; formatting conformance is unverified.
The cargo-clippy component is unavailable in the active Rust toolchain; lint conformance is unverified.
The Tauri desktop shell is authored but has not been built or packaged.
HTTPS termination, pairing, DPoP proof validation, and remote scoped leases are not implemented or verified.
No live Playwright browser effect or browser-evidence custody path has been executed or verified.
No live Wasmtime Component Model or WASI 0.2 host execution has been implemented or verified.
The binding and runtime have not received independent conformance review.
Exact owner approval remains required for a frozen pre-merge candidate.
Framed JSON encoding is implemented, but no Unix-domain socket or equivalent local IPC listener exists.
CLI, local IPC, HTTP/SSE, remote, and desktop clients lack one shared black-box parity suite.
Snapshot qualification, context sufficiency/correction, and complete proposal provenance are incomplete.
The authored uncertain-effect reconciliation operation and event are not implemented.
Bounded and redacted browser evidence custody is not implemented.
The DomainSpec compile receipt records one diagnostic compile, so byte-identical determinism is unproven.
